datasets.name: ytd_kpis
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`YTD Scrap Cost`) as total_scrap_cost, MEASURE(`YTD Units Scrapped`) as total_qty_scrapped FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_operations_metrics

datasets.name: eight_d_status
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Open Reports`) as open_count FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_quality_metrics

datasets.name: supplier_quality_avg
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Avg Quality Score`) as avg_quality FROM main.scrap_demo.supplier_quality_metrics

datasets.name: monthly_trend
queryLines: SELECT `Transaction Month` as year_month, `Transaction Year` as year, MEASURE(`Total Scrap Cost`) as total_scrap_cost, MEASURE(`Total Units Scrapped`) as total_quantity_scrapped FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_operations_metrics GROUP BY `Transaction Month`, `Transaction Year` ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: plant_ytd_summary
queryLines: SELECT `Plant` as plant, MEASURE(`YTD Scrap Cost`) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_operations_metrics GROUP BY `Plant`

datasets.name: defect_pareto
queryLines: SELECT defect_category, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_defect_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY defect_category ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: shift_breakdown
queryLines: SELECT shift, plant_name_lookup as plant, ROUND(SUM(quantity_scrapped), 0) as quantity_scrapped FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY shift, plant_name_lookup

datasets.name: top_scrap_parts
queryLines: SELECT part_id, part_name_lookup, supplier_name_lookup as supplier, plant_name_lookup as plant, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost, ROUND(SUM(quantity_scrapped), 0) as quantity_scrapped FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY part_id, part_name_lookup, supplier_name_lookup, plant_name_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: plant_forecast
queryLines: SELECT year_month, plant_name_lookup as plant, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold GROUP BY year_month, plant_name_lookup ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: supplier_forecast
queryLines: SELECT supplier_name_lookup as supplier, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: seasonal_patterns
queryLines: SELECT transaction_month, day_name, ROUND(AVG(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_daily_summary_gold GROUP BY transaction_month, day_name

datasets.name: feature_importance
queryLines: SELECT defect_category, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_defect_gold GROUP BY defect_category ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 8

datasets.name: supplier_risk
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT supplier_id, supplier_name_lookup as supplier, ROUND(supplier_quality_score, 3) as supplier_quality_score FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE supplier_quality_score < 0.85

datasets.name: supplier_quality_scrap
queryLines: SELECT supplier_name_lookup as supplier, supplier_tier_lookup, ROUND(AVG(supplier_quality_score), 3) as supplier_quality_score, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup, supplier_tier_lookup

datasets.name: supplier_tier_scrap
queryLines: SELECT supplier_tier_lookup, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_tier_lookup

datasets.name: supplier_scorecard
queryLines: SELECT supplier_name_lookup as supplier, supplier_tier_lookup, ROUND(AVG(supplier_quality_score), 3) as supplier_quality_score, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT part_id) as parts_affected FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup, supplier_tier_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: supplier_monthly_trend
queryLines: SELECT year_month, supplier_name_lookup as supplier, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE supplier_name_lookup IN (SELECT supplier_name_lookup FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup ORDER BY SUM(total_scrap_cost) DESC LIMIT 5) GROUP BY year_month, supplier_name_lookup ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: plant_performance
queryLines: SELECT plant_name_lookup as plant, transaction_year as year, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost, ROUND(SUM(quantity_scrapped), 0) as quantity_scrapped FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold WHERE transaction_year >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - 1 GROUP BY plant_name_lookup, transaction_year

datasets.name: work_center_scrap
queryLines: SELECT work_center_type_lookup, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_work_center_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY work_center_type_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC

datasets.name: shift_plant_matrix
queryLines: SELECT plant_name_lookup as plant, shift, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY plant_name_lookup, shift

datasets.name: plant_monthly
queryLines: SELECT year_month, plant_name_lookup as plant, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold GROUP BY year_month, plant_name_lookup ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: eight_d_summary
queryLines: SELECT * FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_closure_rate
queryLines: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as closure_rate FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_timing
queryLines: SELECT ROUND(AVG(days_open), 1) as avg_days FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE status = 'Closed' AND YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_overdue
queryLines: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_overdue = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdue_count FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: root_cause_breakdown
queryLines: SELECT root_cause_category FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_severity
queryLines: SELECT severity, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY severity

datasets.name: eight_d_effectiveness
queryLines: SELECT verification_result FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE status = 'Closed' AND YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: recent_8d_reports
queryLines: SELECT report_number, title, severity, status, days_open, plant_name_lookup as plant FROM main.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver ORDER BY date_opened DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: anomaly_summary
queryLines: SELECT * FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE cost_severity = 'Critical' AND transaction_date >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -30)

datasets.name: anomaly_timeline
queryLines: SELECT transaction_date, ROUND(SUM(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_daily_summary_gold WHERE transaction_date >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -90) GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY transaction_date

datasets.name: defect_clusters
queryLines: SELECT defect_category, ROUND(AVG(total_scrap_cost), 2) as total_scrap_cost, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY defect_category

datasets.name: recent_anomalies
queryLines: SELECT transaction_date, plant_name_lookup as plant, defect_category, ROUND(total_scrap_cost, 2) as total_scrap_cost, quantity_scrapped FROM main.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE cost_severity = 'Critical' ORDER BY transaction_date DESC LIMIT 20
